ctx.x: Like the last four strings on a guitar, the bass.
I see. Okay. So that clears that up. Now, how about the drummers. How did they play? What drummers did you enjoy in New Orleans days? Who did you enjoy working with?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: I guess Henry Martin played snare drum.

ctx.x: He played, he played good, a mellow phone player. He played mellow phone too, huh? He was a pretty good alto player, yeah. Who played bass drum in that? I guess Henry Martin played snare drum.
